verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a web-based government incorporation service, so opting out of telemetry or usage tracking (for example, analytics or cookie consent controls) is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no such control. The partner notification to 'autorizar a partilha de dados' concerns consent to share incorporation data, not usage tracking, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
